title: Portal events bubble through the React tree

slides.say: A portal’s DOM lives in document dot body. But its events still bubble to its React parents.
Click the button. In the DOM it is not inside the div, but the div’s on click still fires.

slides.text: Events follow the React tree, not the DOM tree.
slides.say: Events from portals propagate according to the React tree, not the DOM tree.

slides.text: Problem? Stop propagation inside the portal, or move the portal up.
slides.say: If that causes trouble, stop propagation inside the portal, or move the portal higher in the React tree.
